standards_and_core_docs.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions
standards_and_core_docs.description: Standardised span, metric, and event attributes for LLM and agent calls (gen_ai.operation.name, gen_ai.provider.name, token usage, tool calls, eval results). The conventions moved to a dedicated repo (open-telemetry/semantic-conventions-genai) in 2026. Precise stability tier of gen_ai.client and gen_ai.agent spans is unverified as of 2026-07-11 — secondary sources conflict (some report gen_ai.client reached Stable in early 2026, others report the whole GenAI/MCP surface still Development as of May 2026 with v1.36 as the transition baseline).
standards_and_core_docs.stability_warning: Do not assume gen_ai.client, gen_ai.agent, or MCP conventions are Stable. Check the primary spec and its CHANGELOG before shipping. Use OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental to pin to latest experimental version.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: OpenTelemetry Profiles
ebpf_and_advanced.description: The fourth OTel signal (alongside traces, metrics, logs). Entered public Alpha March 2026. Reference implementation: opentelemetry-ebpf-profiler (Elastic donation). Cross-signal correlation via trace_id/span_id. Target GA Q3 2026. Do not use for critical production workloads yet.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: eBPF Foundation
ebpf_and_advanced.description: eBPF observability use cases and tooling landscape.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: Grafana Beyla
ebpf_and_advanced.description: Open-source eBPF auto-instrumentation agent (Grafana's distribution of the upstream opentelemetry-ebpf-instrumentation / OBI CNCF project) that emits OTel traces and Prometheus metrics without code changes. Beyla's own versioning has moved into the 3.x line since the OBI donation (v3.27.0 confirmed released 2026-07-08) and ships new minor versions roughly weekly; do not cite a specific minor version without checking the releases page first.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: Pixie (CNCF)
ebpf_and_advanced.description: eBPF-based zero-instrumentation observability for Kubernetes; captures requests, profiles, and network flows in-cluster.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: Honeycomb
ebpf_and_advanced.description: High-cardinality wide-event observability platform; accepts OTel traces via OTLP and supports arbitrary GROUP BY at query time.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: SigNoz
ebpf_and_advanced.description: Open-source OTel-native APM with ClickHouse backend; self-hosted alternative to Datadog/New Relic with unified traces, metrics, and logs.

ebpf_and_advanced.name: Coroot
ebpf_and_advanced.description: Open-source APM combining eBPF-based auto-discovery, ClickHouse storage, and automated health inspection for service topology and SLO checks.

llm_observability_and_2026_additions.name: OpenTelemetry Profiles Alpha Announcement

llm_observability_and_2026_additions.name: Deprecating Span Events API
llm_observability_and_2026_additions.description: OTel blog post (March 2026) announcing the deprecation of Span.AddEvent and Span.RecordException in favour of log-based events via the Logs API.

llm_observability_and_2026_additions.name: Prometheus Native Histograms — GA Announcement
llm_observability_and_2026_additions.description: Grafana Labs announcement of Prometheus native histograms reaching GA (October 2025). Eliminates bucket pre-selection; requires protobuf exposition; treat rollout as infrastructure change.

llm_observability_and_2026_additions.name: OpenTelemetry GenAI Observability (blog 2026)
llm_observability_and_2026_additions.description: OTel blog (2026) covering LLM tracing, agent span hierarchies, token-usage metrics, and eval event integration using GenAI semconv.
